messages:
maria: FYI PR #42836 -- fallback for KV cache eviction + dynamic batching. Need runtime, infra, security eyes before we can schedule canary. Please ping if you can review today.

alex: Link?

maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/42836 — changes: `eviction/threshold` default lowered, adds `batching_fallback` flag, unit tests + perf samples. TL;DR: better tail latency under pressure, slight perf hit at p50.

jon: I can review runtime bits. Can you add a quick perf summary in the PR description? Need to know expected p99 impact and test harness used.

maria: Added the perf snapshot to PR. p50 +1.2%, p95 +3.4%, p99 +6.0% on our standard linear-16k reg test. Harness: /infra/test/harness/seqbench. Also added a note on fallback policy param names.

sara: I can own the canary. When do you want to run it and which pool? `dedicated-gpu-canary-2`?

maria: Thanks. Targeting Tue 02:00 PST -> `dedicated-gpu-canary-2`. Canary steps in PR description. Quick question for infra: any special quota tickets needed for that pool?

kevin: infra here. No quota tickets needed for that pool, but please add `canary-duration: 30m` to the PR ops checklist. Also verify `kv_cache.size_bytes` telemetry is enabled.

sara: Will run canary and collect kv_cache, latency, and error traces. Ping me if you need logs. Short snippet I used to validate locally:
```
./run_seqbench --model=gpt-neo --seq_len=2048 --concurrency=8 --duration=60
```

linda: eng-security: quick note — PR touches KMS key usage and adds a new audit tag. I need the KMS key id in the PR and confirmation that keys are customer-managed only in private deploys. Also flagging for compliance doc update.

maria: KMS key id added in the secure notes section. We're not changing behavior in hosted mode.

ci-bot: CI ✅ all checks passed (unit + integration). perf-run: green

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @sara for Tue 02:00 PST on `dedicated-gpu-canary-2`. I'll post results summary when complete.

alex: Thanks — I'll take runtime + perf review by EOD today. If no blockers, can we aim to merge Wed morning after canary?

maria: Sounds good. If security signoff by tomorrow morning and no regressions in canary, merging Wed 09:00 PST. :thumbsup:
